definition: Deviating from what is standard, normal, or expected.
example: One anomalous vote interrupted the unanimous pattern.
nuance: Anomalous describes deviation and does not itself explain the cause.
prompt: A scientist checks an unusual measurement.
options: The anomalous reading differed sharply from every previous result.
The anomalous reading exactly matched the expected pattern.
The reading was anomalous because it was typical.
Anomalous meant the scientist disliked the reading.
reasons: Departure from the established pattern is anomalous.
A personal preference does not establish an anomaly.
